issues: A/B 两页都是灰色占位 dashboard，翻换前后几乎同色，波扫过去看不出换了什么
叶片翻换是 scaleX 横向挤压的伪 3D，读作两张图在挤，不是百叶窗
缝上的三层 SVG 亮线是贴上去的装饰，叶片本身没有受光与体积
10f 一叶、2f 等差错峰，节奏机械；翻完后 98f 什么都不发生
changes: look 改为 paper，瑞士网格杂志的翻页：虚构排版季刊《FORMA》两页——暖白纸 + 墨色 400px 巨字「Grid.」→ 整版朱红 + 奶白巨字「Rhythm.」，反差让每一叶都读得清
版面用 12 栏 × 160px 网格（发丝线可见）——栏 = 叶片，百叶窗沿着版式网格翻页，形式与手法同构
改成真 3D 叶片：preserve-3d 双面板（正面 A / 背面 B），共享 1900px 透视绕竖轴 0→180°；侧立时露出叶后暗槽，背光面按 sin θ 变暗、~35° 掠过一道高光、叶缘受光细线
节奏：每叶物理弹簧（~13f 到位、≈5° 过冲拍到位），起跳按 t^0.78 错峰（间隔 3.4f→2.1f，越翻越快）；波期间相机 1→1.02 再落回
收敛后摘罩（3D 全部卸载、B 页文字锐利），刊头细线重新画出作为落定一拍；时长 150→132f
issuesEn: Both pages are grey placeholder dashboards of nearly the same tone, so you can't see what changed as the wave passes
The slat flip is a scaleX squash fake-3D — it reads as two images squeezing, not blinds
The three-layer SVG seam line is a pasted-on decoration; the slats themselves have no light or volume
10f per slat with linear 2f stagger feels mechanical, and nothing happens for 98f after the wave
changesEn: Look switched to paper, a Swiss-grid magazine page turn: two spreads of the fictional type quarterly 'FORMA' — warm paper with a 400px ink 'Grid.' → full-bleed vermilion with a cream 'Rhythm.'; the contrast makes every slat legible
Layout uses a visible 12-column × 160px grid — columns are the slats, so the blinds turn along the layout grid itself

Real 3D slats: preserve-3d double-sided panels (A front / B back) rotating 0→180° about their own axis under a shared 1900px perspective; edge-on slats reveal a dark cavity, faces darken by sin θ, catch a highlight near 35° and get a lit edge

Rhythm: each slat flips on a physical spring (~13f, ~5° overshoot snapping into place), starts staggered by t^0.78 (gaps 3.4f→2.1f, accelerating wave); camera pushes 1→1.02 and settles during the wave
After settling the 3D is unmounted (crisp B type) and the masthead rule redraws as the landing beat; duration 150→132f
